description: Covers B7, B11, B12. core_pin reads VERSION from ctx.core_root and gets the failing-fixture test on a throwaway dirty core (B7); it resolves the core's git status with the core's own GIT_DIR, not one leaked from a superproject hook in a linked worktree (B11); on a shallow submodule it compares against the pinned tag's commit instead of failing on "tags exist, none on HEAD" (B12).
title: core_pin: testable, worktree-safe, shallow-safe
